wiki_text: GIIGNL's 2026 Annual Report states: 'Bilbao (BBG): Bahia de Bizkaia Gas launched a bio-LNG supply service for ships and trucks at its Bilbao terminal in February 2026, following obtaining of ISCC EU certification.'
